responsibility: Constructs IRA conflict information between allocno objects and augments allocnos with copy and hard-register conflict data. It builds and compresses the object conflict bit table from allocno live ranges, records pairwise conflicts canonically across subobjects, propagates copies for regional allocation, and adds architectural hard-register exclusions such as call-clobbered, debugging, and paradoxical-subreg constraints. The resulting object conflict arrays and per-object conflict hard-reg sets are the main interference inputs to IRA coloring.
